# Shoring Insurance

> Shoring Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides commercial insurance for this trade in all 50 states. Coverage lines: General Liability Insurance for Shoring Contractors, Professional Liability (E&O) for Shoring Contractors, Workers' Compensation for Shoring Contractors, Commercial Auto for Shoring Contractors, Umbrella / Excess Liability for Shoring Contractors, Inland Marine / Equipment Floater for Shoring Contractors, Builders Risk / Installation Floater for Shoring Contractors, Pollution Liability for Shoring Contractors. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
